meta_description: Tom Pearson Painter & Decorator in Manchester. Interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes, attention to detail. Call 07789 248335.
hero_eyebrow: Interior & Exterior Specialist — Reliable, Meticulous Work
hero_subhead: Interior redecoration, exterior paintwork, and wallpapering done right first time. No fuss, no mess.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: From interior feature walls to full exterior repaints, Tom handles every job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and bathrooms painted to a professional finish. We prep walls properly and use quality paint that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof masonry and woodwork painting. We assess condition, repair as needed, and apply finishes that protect your home for years.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Feature walls, full room coverage, or difficult spaces. Expertly hung with no bubbles, seams invisible, and a finish that looks sharp.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, window frames, and built-ins finished in gloss or satin. We sand, prime, and paint for a lasting result.

services.title: Cladding & Render Painting
services.desc: Modern render and cladding systems painted cleanly with breathable finishes. Ideal for updating Manchester's terraced and detached homes.

services.title: Prep & Repair Work
services.desc: We don't cut corners. Cracks filled, loose plaster replastered, and old paint stripped before decoration. The prep is what makes it last.

about_pullquote: I prep like it matters because the finish only looks good if the base is right.
about_para_1: Tom Pearson has been painting and decorating homes across Manchester for over 15 years. He started as an apprentice, learned the trade properly, and built his reputation on attention to detail and honest pricing. Every job — whether a single bedroom or a full exterior repaint — gets the same meticulous approach.
about_para_2: His customers come back because he leaves a home cleaner than he found it, never cuts corners on prep, and prices fairly without hidden charges. Tom works alone or with a trusted small team, so you know who's in your home and what to expect.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Tom

reviews.text: Tom painted our lounge and two bedrooms during lockdown. Arrived on time, worked cleanly, and the finish is perfect. He even moved all our furniture carefully and put it back exactly where it was. Proper tradesman. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had Tom repaint our front door and skirting boards after years of wear. He stripped the old paint back, filled gaps, and the finish is crisp and clean. Not the cheapest quote but worth every penny. Will use again when we redecorate upstairs.
reviews.author: Claire W.

reviews.text: Exterior of our terraced house needed doing badly. Tom assessed it, quoted fairly, and got the job done in a week. No mess left behind, and the paint is standing up brilliantly through the Manchester weather. Really pleased with the work.
reviews.author: David L.
